lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c> with special conditions that differ from
the normal <c:ffff00>{{basic_rules}}<c>.

If there are entry conditions, <c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c> that don't
meet them can't be sent out.

If there are conditions for deciding victory or defeat,
meeting only the victory {{condition_rotation}} of the {{basic_rules}}
is not enough to win.
